Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, B.V. NAGARATHNA
Consumer Protection Act, 1986 – s.21 – Insurance – Repudiation of claim on ground of suppression or non-disclosure of material facts – Appellant intended to travel to the USA – Appellant was issued a overseas policy – The appellant was medically examined at the instance of respondent No. 1 insurance company prior to the consideration of his request for issuance of a mediclaim policy – The medical report categorically noted that the appellant had diabetes-type II (mellitus- II) –
Decision Date : 06-12-2021 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 8386/2015 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
